screens.title: 1 · Notas first, remembered
screens.why: The project opens on what it is about; the device keeps the last tab chosen.

pins.label: Notas · Tarefas
pins.text: Order switched: Notas is the first segment. The tab last chosen is kept on the device (shared_preferences, like Lista/Calendário) and every project opens on it.

pins.label: Notes
pins.text: Unchanged: free text, saved as it is written.

pins.label: No dock here
pins.text: Nothing floats over the notes: the + and the bar appear on Tarefas only.

screens.title: 2 · Tempo's Lista, kept to the project
screens.why: Not a look-alike: the same TimelineList widget, filtered to the project's tasks.

pins.label: Fazer em breve
pins.text: The project's tasks with an hour, the hours Tempo gives them. Same spacing, headings, pinned heading, + Adicionar.

pins.label: Gestures
pins.text: Exactly Tempo's: hold to move up, down, across the line; carry right = done; carry left = delete (confirmed); tap = the task's page.

pins.label: Depois eu priorizo
pins.text: Tempo's own backlog. A project task is no longer parked off the day: new ones land at the end of the backlog.

pins.label: N feitas
pins.text: Third stage, always drawn: done tasks, newest first, quiet with a check. Tap opens notes; not a drop target.

pins.label: Pergunte à Lunna
pins.text: Tempo's AskDock, same behaviour (voice included). Later: the conversation knows the project (separate research).
Writes where the list looks, like Tempo, and the task belongs to this project.

screens.title: 3 · Tap opens the task
screens.why: Same EventPage as Tempo: title, controls, notes.

pins.label: EventPage
pins.text: Pushed from the project; back returns to the project.

pins.label: Notes
pins.text: The task's notes, edited in place.

screens.title: 4 · + on the project
screens.why: The same creation sheet as Tempo.

pins.label: Where it goes
pins.text: Flexível/Fixo, length and hour as on Tempo; saved with this project's id.

screens.title: 5 · Tempo, for comparison
screens.why: The same list unfiltered: the project's tasks sit among the rest of the day.

pins.label: Lista
pins.text: Untouched. The project page is this, filtered, plus Feitas.

pins.label: Shared rows
pins.text: Ligar para a transportadora is the same row in both: a move in either moves it in both.
